name: Shinju
source:
Shinju is the lead police detective in charge of pursuit of [url=https://vndb.org/c1786]Hanabi[/url]. She got pulled into [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url]'s world by accident. Surprisingly, she gets along well with the cats she's been forced to be around, even though she's their natural enemy, a canine. Her self-discipline comes from her military background. While she's proud of her job, she's also self-conscious, worrying that it obscures her femininity.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/35340]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
